messages: nina: quick heads-up — running the weekly link scan on /runtime and found 3 broken anchors. small things, but they break a few runbook links: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime#batched-requests, https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime#kv-cache, https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime#autoscale link-bot: automated-scan: 3 broken anchor(s) detected in /runtime (ids: batched-requests, kv-cache, autoscale). suggestion: add explicit anchor tags or align header text to canonical slug. omar: :eyes: can you drop the exact lines/headers? i can whip up a tiny PR if someone confirms the intended header text. nina: sure — quick grep output: ``` $ rg "Batched requests|KV cache|Autoscale" docs/runtime.md -n 142:# Batching and throughput 215:# KV cache details 310:# Autoscaling policies ``` looks like the headings exist but the slugs changed when we switched to the new mdx slugger. easiest fix is adding explicit anchors next to those headers. jules: i can take batched-requests + kv-cache. should i convert to explicit HTML anchors like `` above the headers, or rename headers to the older slug? claudia: i'm runtime guide owner — prefer explicit anchors so we don't modify header copy. happy to review PRs. i'll aim to CR before 15:00 PT. omar: +1 for explicit anchors. tiny sed i use locally: ```bash awk 'NR==142{print ""} {print}' docs/runtime.md > tmp && mv tmp docs/runtime.md ``` use same pattern for the other two. i'll run link-checker after PR to verify. jules: grabbing two now, will open a draft PR with the three new anchors and short PR description: "fix: add explicit anchors for legacy runbook links". tagging @claudia for review. nina: amazing — added to docs-sprint board under "quick fixes". ping here if you need me to re-run the scan or grab any followups. :tada: claudia: thanks team — will prioritize review after lunch. if anyone needs a quick merge, DM me and i'll bump it up. :hand: omar: once PR is up i'll run `link-bot scan` and post results in thread. link-bot: scheduled-scan queued: will post results after PR merge. nina: perfect. thanks all!
